'''Hermann Boerner''' (or '''Börner'''<ref>[http://swb.bsz-bw.de/DB=2.114/CMD?ACT=SRCHA&IKT=2011&TRM=pnd:117708429&REC=2 record] at [[Baden-Württemberg]] library service center</ref>) (11 July 1906 – 3 June 1982) was a German mathematician who worked on [[variation calculus]], [[complex analysis]], and [[group representation]] theory.

==Publications==
*{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130212060356/http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/no_cache/dms/load/img/?IDDOC=253172|title=Boerner ''Carathéodorys Eingang zur Variationsrechnung'', Jahresbericht DMV 1953}}
*[https://web.archive.org/web/20151219100441/http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/no_cache/dms/load/img/?IDDOC=20043 Boerner ''Variationsrechnung aus dem Stokesschen Satz'', Mathematische Zeitschrift volume 46, 1940, page 709]
*[https://web.archive.org/web/20151206191132/http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/no_cache/dms/load/img/?IDDOC=20044 Boerner ''Über die Legendreschen Bedingungen und die Feldtheorie in der Variationsrechnung der mehrfachen Integrale'', Mathem.Zeitschrift 1940, page 720]
*{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130212093902/http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/no_cache/dms/load/img/?IDDOC=37329|title=Boerner ''Über die Extremalen und geodätischen Felder in der Variationsrechnung der mehrfachen Integrale'', Mathematische Annalen volume 112, 1936, page 187}}
*{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130106072304/http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/no_cache/dms/load/img/?IDDOC=193781|title=Boerner ''Darstellungstheorie der endlichen Gruppen'', Teubner 1967, Enzyklopädie der mathematischen Wissenschaften}}
*{{cite book|last=Boerner|first= Hermann|title=Representations of groups, with special consideration for the needs of modern physics|translator= P. G. Murphy|edition =Second|publisher= [[North-Holland Publishing]] | year = 1970}}
